rationale: C04 is the closest because it delegates presidential authority to named administrators through numbered operative provisions, but that is generic administrative machinery and its detailed multi-agency regulatory scheme does not parallel the child's two-part authorization to transfer alien property before or after claim adjudication. C03 shares only the executive-order form and a direct operative command, while C02 shares statutory recitals and an exercise of presidential authority; neither contains distinctive language, sequencing, or transfer-and-indemnification machinery plausibly reused in the child.
